_rules: Format v6 (from 18 Nov 2026): 'Which of the ten are you?' reels, Wednesdays 19:00, one form per week in this order (alternating Season and Sky). On screen: Inner Constellation names only (the essence name and the site's label 'Wood, bold'); the classical name (Yang Wood, Jia) goes in the caption. hook[1] is a behaviour people recognise in themselves (<= 52 characters); reveal <= 46; strength and catch are [headline <= 36, line <= 48]; always balanced: a strength, then the catch, kindly put. Spec: tools/forms/<slug>.json {stem, essence, hook:[lead, line], reveal, strength, catch, comment_line, caption}. Scenes (ChatGPT, from the form's reference sheet): media/<date>/art5e/hook.png shows the form doing the hook behaviour; optional 01-, 02-, 03- for the three cards. The first reel of this set needs Stanley's 'Approve reel' (evening status 'review'); later ones follow the day's status. Mark 'used': '<date>' when scheduled. After all ten, start a second round with new hooks.

hook: Is this you?
You plan everyone's holiday and never ask for help.
forms.reveal: Tall, steady, the one others lean on.
strength: People build on you.
You hold the plan when everyone else wobbles.
catch: You bend last.
Asking for help feels like losing. It isn't.

hook: Is this you?
You remember how everyone takes their kopi.
strength: You make people feel looked after.
Small care, every day, adds up.
catch: You worry for everyone.
Leave some of that care for yourself.

hook: Is this you?
You walk in and the room gets louder.
strength: You light people up.
Your energy is what gets things started.
catch: You promise more than a day holds.
Even the sun sets. Rest before you burn out.

hook: Is this you?
You spot the typo on a menu across the room.
strength: You make things beautiful.
The last five percent is where you shine.
catch: Perfect takes too long.
Done and good beats flawless and late.

hook: Is this you?
You already decided. The meeting is still going.
forms.reveal: Direct, brave, quick to cut through.
strength: You make the hard call.
Others wait. You choose and move.
catch: Your words can cut.
Sharp is useful. Aim it carefully.

hook: Is this you?
You knew how it would end before anyone spoke.
strength: You sense what is unsaid.
People feel understood around you.
catch: Moods roll in like weather.
Name the feeling. It passes sooner.

hook: Is this you?
Everyone brings you their problems. You keep yours.
forms.reveal: Calm, solid, the ground others stand on.
strength: You don't panic.
In a crisis, people look for you first.
catch: You won't budge.
Steady is good. Stuck is different.

hook: Is this you?
You always find a way round, and nobody sees how.
forms.reveal: Soft on the outside, impossible to stop.
strength: You adapt and still get there.
Blocked path? You grow around it.
catch: You bend too far for others.
Not every yes is yours to give.

hook: Is this you?
Twelve tabs open. Three trips half planned.
strength: You think wide.
New ideas and new people find you.
catch: You scatter.
Pick one river and follow it.

hook: Is this you?
You notice what everyone else missed. At 2 am.
forms.reveal: A small light that goes deep.
strength: You see into people.
One honest talk with you changes things.
catch: You overthink in the dark.
Not every thought needs finishing tonight.
